analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 33.5, entering oversold territory, continuing decline from 43.6 five days ago. MACD histogram worsened from 0.3885 to -0.3599, maintaining a death cross. ADX at 25.5 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (41.7) is significantly higher than +DI (15.8), showing bearish pressure. Weekly RSI is 33.0 and weekly MACD histogram is -0.3776, indicating continued weakness. Daily Bollinger Band is approaching the lower band at $64.49.
